projects.title: YT Tracker Mobile
bullets: Built a Swift iOS app to track and organize saved videos across 32 files over nine active days.
Documented local setup steps after a classmate could not get the project running from the README.

projects.title: Editormain
bullets: Maintained a C# editor tool with custom ShaderLab and HLSL shaders across 485 files and 200 commits.
Wrote inline comments and a changelog so contributors could follow shader changes without asking directly.

projects.title: Portfolioito
bullets: Built a personal portfolio site in Swift and TypeScript to showcase mobile and web projects.
Reorganized the project's structure after a peer struggled to find where key components lived.

leadership.title: New Member Guide Writer
